title: Fan-in: merge channels
hints: Start one goroutine per non-nil input; each one copies its input to the shared output. Several goroutines may send on one channel, but only one party may close it, and only after all senders are done.
A `sync.WaitGroup` counts the copying goroutines. One extra goroutine does `wg.Wait()` and then `close(out)`, so Merge itself can return straight away.

`out := make(chan T); var wg sync.WaitGroup; for _, in := range inputs { if in == nil { continue }; wg.Go(func() { for v := range in { out <- v } }) }; go func() { wg.Wait(); close(out) }(); return out`.
